title: Pet Insurance Premium Premium Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petinsurance:premium premium_usd=*
| stats sum(premium_usd) as total_value, avg(premium_usd) as avg_value by pet_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks pet values by total and average premium amount across pet insurance premium events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `premium_usd` values for each pet insurance premium event and review total and average premium amount by pet.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total premium amount.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which pet shows the biggest premium amount numbers in your pet insurance premium data.
